articles.title: Anthropic presenta su S‑1: ¿inversión en milagros o riesgo existencial?
articles.raw_content:
Investing in any stock is kind of like gambling in the sense that you're betting your money on a company's future performance. But how do you bet on a technology that could, in the worst-case scenario, "pose catastrophic or existential risks to humanity," or best case, "bring forth an age of miracles"?

To some extent, Anthropic suggests in a letter at the top of its S-1 filing, you have to just believe.

Anthropic's 335-page S-1 prospectus, filed Monday, is part of a steady hype escalation in Silicon Valley's interactions with Wall Street. In some ways, it's not even that bizarre; SpaceX IPO'd in June after filing an S-1 that referenced din …

Read the full story at The Verge.
articles.summary: La firma de IA Anthropic ha presentado su prospecto S‑1, subrayando la necesidad de creer en su tecnología. El documento, de 335 páginas, destaca tanto el potencial de revolucionar la industria como los riesgos existenciales que podrían acompañar a la IA. La presentación refleja la creciente relación entre Silicon Valley y Wall Street, con un tono de apuesta y cautela.

articles.title: El D2D sale del laboratorio: Orange, Skylo y Kyivstar lanzan continuidad
articles.raw_content: Two direct-to-device services, one from GEO, one from LEO In sum – what to know: For all the discussion of 6G architectures and WRC-27 agenda items, direct-to-device (D2D) is already a…
articles.summary: El D2D ya no es solo teoría. Orange, Skylo y Kyivstar han puesto en marcha servicios de continuidad directa a dispositivo, aprovechando constelaciones GEO y LEO. La iniciativa avanza en paralelo con la agenda de 6G y la WRC‑27, demostrando que la conectividad de extremo a extremo ya está disponible comercialmente.

articles.title: Contratista de defensa permite acceso de su agente IA personal al Pentágono
articles.raw_content: Sources tell WIRED that an Accenture employee’s personal Claude agent ran on a DOD network for two months before it was identified and the vulnerability could be patched.
articles.summary: Un empleado de Accenture dejó que su agente Claude personal operara en la red del Departamento de Defensa durante dos meses antes de ser detectado. La brecha se identificó y se pudo corregir, evitando un riesgo mayor.

articles.title: Anthropic apuesta por el cómputo masivo para asegurar su crecimiento
articles.raw_content:
The Anthropic S-1 seems to have provided the financial justification for the company to spend as much as it possibly can on compute. If you are the kind of person who wonders if Anthropic is doing its level best to build a machine god while convincing Wall Street it's in the business of selling IT contracts, Anthropic has just offered a handy solution: Doing a bunch of things that look like you're trying to build the machine god is the only way to avoid going bankrupt.

Forget about the machine god for a minute. At least in my read of the S-1, it seems like Anthropic is pinning the future of its company to dramatic growth; it has to, in orde …

Read the full story at The Verge.
articles.summary: El S‑1 de Anthropic revela que la compañía justifica enormes gastos en cómputo como estrategia para impulsar un crecimiento explosivo y evitar la quiebra. La narrativa de “construir un dios de la IA” sirve más como argumento de mercado que como objetivo real, orientándose a contratos de TI y a la rentabilidad a largo plazo.

articles.title: Deepgram adquiere Daily, creador de Pipecat, para reforzar su infraestructura de IA de voz

articles.title: Meta lanza Waddle World, diario de mascotas con IA
articles.raw_content:
Meta has launched a "tamagotchi-style" pet game called Waddle World, with virtual creatures that chat with users and create doodles to illustrate conversations.

According to its Apple and Play Store listings, the "16-bit pet care game" is not really a game, but "a daily journal disguised as a pet." Users should talk, not type, with their pets, the description says, as well as play "cozy games" like stacking groceries or word games. The Play store description says:

A little friend that listens. A cozy world that's yours. Waddle World is a cozy 16-bit world where your pixel pet lives. Hatch a virtual pet, visit whenever you like, and let it …

Read the full story at The Verge.
articles.summary: Meta lanza Waddle World, una app de diario de mascotas con IA que permite a los usuarios conversar y crear dibujos con sus criaturas virtuales.

articles.title: España y Europa en riesgo por sabotaje chino a cables submarinos del Pacífico
articles.raw_content:
Subsea cable projects owned by US companies such as Google and Meta face some of the greatest risks from the threat of deep-sea sabotage in the Pacific Ocean, according to a new report. That coincides with Chinese research ships spending an extraordinary amount of time apparently surveying undersea cables—not to mention Chinese commercial ships being investigated for cutting cables in both European and Asian waters.

Most damage to the undersea cables that form the Internet’s backbone is the result of accidents involving bottom-trawling fishing nets and ship anchors dragging on the seabed, with storms and undersea landslides also factoring in. But the recent rise in international tensions and open conflicts have placed new scrutiny on more suspicious instances of cable-cutting damage, with analysts warning about Russia and China in particular engaging in cable sabotage or tampering as “gray zone” tactics that fall short of direct military confrontation.

One of the newest risk assessments of China’s gray zone tactics targeting the Internet’s undersea infrastructure comes from a research report published by the US-China Economic and Security Review Commission, an independent government commission that advises Congress. The report was contracted to the London-based think tank China Strategic Risks Institute and published in September 2026.

Read full article

Comments
articles.summary: El informe de la US-China Economic y seguridad Review Commission alerta que los cables submarinos de Google y Meta, esenciales para la conectividad europea, están bajo amenaza de sabotaje chino en el Pacífico. El aumento de investigaciones sobre barcos chinos que inspeccionan y cortan cables en aguas europeas subraya el riesgo para la infraestructura digital de España y la UE.

articles.title: Los agentes de IA, la nueva audiencia de los medios

articles.title: Verizon refuta el hype de SpaceX: sin atajos ni soluciones milagrosas

La compañía rechaza el hype de SpaceX, subrayando que no existen atajos ni soluciones milagrosas para el crecimiento. La actualización refuerza la posición de Verizon como líder en servicios de telecomunicaciones y tecnología.

articles.title: Anthropic presenta prospecto de IPO y apunta a revolucionar la IA
articles.raw_content:
Anthropic has filed its S-1 prospectus with the Securities and Exchange Commission, preparing the company behind Claude to beat OpenAI to the punch with an IPO. In a filing with the SEC, Anthropic said it plans to list on the Nasdaq exchange under the ticker symbol "ANT."

The AI company confidentially filed with the SEC earlier this year in June, but the public document reveals more details, as well as the company's plans for the future in its own words, as well as potential risks for investors and the world. According to the S-1, in the first half of this year Anthropic had an $80.7 billion net loss on $16.3 billion in revenue. As previou …

Read the full story at The Verge.
articles.summary: Anthropic ha presentado su prospecto S‑1 ante la SEC, planificando su salida a bolsa en Nasdaq con el ticker ANT. El informe revela pérdidas netas de 80,7 bn USD sobre ingresos de 16,3 bn USD en la primera mitad del año, y su ambición de revolucionar todos los ámbitos con IA.

La solución, que combina inteligencia artificial con redes de acceso radio, atrae a operadores de la región EMEA, que buscan optimizar costes y rendimiento en sus infraestructuras de telecomunicaciones.

articles.title: Locutor IA de radio, bilingüe y defensor de inmigrantes, conquista audiencias en España
articles.raw_content: Coyotec is bilingual, swears, and tells listeners how to defend themselves against ICE. Its popularity comes as more broadcasters are experimenting with artificial personalities.
articles.summary: Coyotec, locutor de radio IA que habla español y defiende a inmigrantes, gana popularidad en España. El programa, que incluye lenguaje coloquial y consejos legales contra ICE, refleja la tendencia europea de experimentar con personalidades artificiales en medios.
